features: Created over 60 test students across two classes via batch CSV import
Enforces 6 compulsory subjects and exactly 1 optional 4th subject per student
Subject schema explicitly splits marks into Theory (out of 75) and Practical (out of 25) components
System handles hard edge cases explicitly: absent in a subject, practical component failure despite high theory, and optional subject underperformance
Strict dual-pass rule enforcement: Theory must be >= 25 AND Practical must be >= 8. Failing either yields 0.00 GP
Absent mapping: AB marks calculate to 0.00 GP
4th Optional subject bonus math: max(0, GP - 2.00)
Final GPA mapped from the sum of 6 compulsory subject GPs + optional bonus, divided by 6, capped at 5.00
Compulsory fail override: Failing any compulsory subject immediately outputs 0.00 GPA and Letter Grade F
Step-by-step calculation trace UI explicitly built for every student
Trace logs the exact marks used, the precise GP awarded per subject, and the governing rule
For students failing with a high uncancelled average, the trace explicitly points out the specific subject causing the Compulsory Failure Override Rule
Automated auditing dashboard generating checking lists prior to result publication
Filters students whose optional subject grade point was <= 2.0 (did not help)
Filters students who triggered a Practical Fail condition (< 8 in practical part)
Filters students who received an AB (Absent) mark in any subject
